title: Preserve unmatched records on the required side of a join
goal: Compare expected and observed records while retaining every entry from the side that must remain complete.

selectionNotes: Choose LeftJoin to retain expected rows or RightJoin to retain observed rows; neither retains both unmatched sides.
Queryable availability does not establish database-provider translation.
